irac.issue: Whether the Mysore Agricultural Debtors Relief Act, 1956, applies to a pending suit against a member of the Board of Agriculture.
irac.rule: The Mysore Agricultural Debtors Relief Act, 1956, does not apply to pending suits unless expressly stated; general language of the Act is not enough to imply retrospective effect.
irac.application: The Act does not contain express words making it retrospective; therefore, it does not apply to pending suits.
irac.conclusion: The Mysore Agricultural Debtors Relief Act, 1956, does not apply to the pending suit against the member of the Board of Agriculture.
